did: Continued the APK walkthrough (WALK5) on claude/walk5-voice, no pull request. Each stop now says authored narration, part promo and part mission, never what is on screen, followed by what real use shows of that stop; the chapter and silence cards stay silent, as the owner ruled. Home's weekly numbers are read onto the app's own module list (frictionOf), said honestly as moved on and stretches, with any count under five withheld. The walkthrough command can now ask home's speaker for its lines itself, and Applying's debrief is said. A fresh review's nine findings were fixed, among them narration that claimed more privacy than is true.

have home emit the walkthrough's numbers
